title: One-Punch Man OVA
summary: AniList 21416 bundles the six OVAs that shipped as 映像特典 on the six S1 Blu-ray / DVD volumes: #01 忍び寄りすぎる影 (vol 1, BCXA-1038 / BCBA-4720, 2015-12-24, 約12分), #02 話ベタすぎる弟子 (vol 2, BCXA-1039, 2016-01-29, 約11分), #03 こじれすぎる忍者 (vol 3, BCXA-1040, 2016-02-24), #04 強引すぎるバング (vol 4, BCXA-1041, 2016-03-25), #05 色々ありすぎる姉妹 (vol 5, BCXA-1042, 2016-04-22) and #06 不可能すぎる殺人事件 (vol 6, BCXA-1043, 2016-05-27) — count, disc and date from the official site's six per-volume pages, ja-WP's BD/DVD table and the 2018 BOX page ('TV本編全12話＋OVA全6話'). NONE of the six adapts a printed unit of the instrument, and the licensor says so on every disc: each volume's 映像特典 block prints 「ONE原案による完全オリジナルストーリー」, ja-WP's BD section repeats it verbatim ('映像特典としてONE原案による完全オリジナルストーリーのOVAを収録'), and ANN's report of the 2015-11-15 announcement reads 'Original manga creator ONE will write the original story for all six OVAs' (the screenplays are Tomohiro Suzuki's on all six per en-WP's writer column). I re-ran Road to Hero's sweep of the 45 bonus chapters against these six plots — none matches — and read the numbered chapters that surround each OVA's setting (ch 30-51 in full, on top of the fandom's ep 1-12 map ch 1-37): ch 30's dojo scene is Bang demonstrating 水流岩砕拳 and Genos flattening Charanko, not OVA #04's memory-card and rock-paper-scissors duel, and the manga's post-Boros chapters (37 Crash → 38 King) hold no hot-spring party. The wiki's own curated 'Anime-Only Characters § OVAs' list is exactly the six characters these OVAs invented — Men's Esthetician Man, Don Pacino, Frank, Ino, Serial Bomber, Swim — and each character page files the OVA under 'Appearances in Other Media' with 'Chapter(s): OVA n'. So the entry is filler under T27, with no chapter entry and not even a sliver: the only source-adjacent frames are re-shown ones (OVA #03 opens on nightmare replays of Sonic's ep-4 defeat; OVA #01 closes by walking Genos up to the apartment door that ch 8 / ep 2 already animated), which the recap / re-staging clause makes weightless and uncitable. Two things worth the file: the discs place each OVA exactly where its own story sits (#01 inside ep 2, #03 after ep 4, #04 after ep 7, #05 after ep 9, #06 after ep 12), and OVA #05 is Fubuki's FIRST anime appearance — three years and a season before ep 14 animates her manga debut (ch 42-45).

position.why: Confirmed — but on the bundle's LAST member, not on the air date. OVA #06 opens on the aftermath of the Dark Matter Thieves' invasion, which the TV run closes in ep 12 (ch 35-37), so no earlier slot is safe for the whole bundle; the other five sit at 2.5 (#01: 'between Mosquito Girl's defeat and Genos showing up in Saitama's Apartment' — inside ep 2, ch 5-8), ~3-4 (#02: no TV beat pins it; disc 2 carries eps 3-4), 4.5 (#03: en-WP 'After the events of episode 4'), 7.5 (#04: after the meteor of ep 7) and 9.5 (#05: after the Deep Sea King of ep 9, the next morning's newspaper). The licensor never orders them inside the run: the 2018 BD/DVD BOX lists 本編全12話＋OVA全6話 as a block, and the 2025 streaming release numbers the S1 set 'OVA 1 #00〜#06' with Road to Hero as #00 — OVA-set ordinals, not run positions. 12.5 is where the air-date derivation happened to land, so the stored value stands with a better reason.

flags_for_sean: BUNDLE: six OVAs, one AniList id, ONE standing — and unlike attack-on-titan__18397 every member is filler, so the bundle is filler with no mixed question to answer. If it is ever split, the slots are #01 → 2.5, #02 → 3-4 (no beat pins it; disc 2 carries eps 3-4), #03 → 4.5, #04 → 7.5, #05 → 9.5, #06 → 12.5. Structural finding: each disc's OVA sits exactly where the two TV episodes on that same disc end, so the disc order IS the story order.

ONE's 原案 IS A CREDIT, NOT AN ADOPTION (T26, Sean 2026-09-05): the licensor prints 「ONE原案による完全オリジナルストーリー」 on all six volumes and ANN reports 'Original manga creator ONE will write the original story for all six OVAs'; en-WP credits 脚本 Tomohiro Suzuki on all six. Nothing from these stories ever entered the manga line — ten years on, the six characters they invented are still the fandom's curated 'Anime-Only Characters § OVAs' list. adopted = null.

DATE SPAN: AniList's single 2015-12-24 is disc 1's date alone; the bundle runs 2015-12-24 → 2016-05-27 (2015-12-24 / 2016-01-29 / 02-24 / 03-25 / 04-22 / 05-27). If the ledger row carries a date, the honest value is that span, or #01's date labelled as the first disc. AniList's GraphQL API answered 403 ('temporarily disabled') throughout this task — every date here is from the licensor, ja-WP or ANN, none guessed.

SOURCE DEFECTS for any later date join: (a) en-WP's OVA table prints the wrong dates for #02-#06 — Jan 28 / Feb 25 / Mar 29 / Apr 23 / May 31 against the licensor + ja-WP + ANN's Jan 29 / Feb 24 / Mar 25 / Apr 22 / May 27; (b) the LIVE official page for volume 5 misprints '2016.3.25' (a copy of volume 4's date) — the 2016 archived version of the same page reads '2016.4.22 Release'. Trust the archived licensor page and ja-WP.

UNVERIFIED WIKI FIELD, deliberately not used: Swim's infobox carries 'manga = Volume 11', but no chapter page, no volume page and no backlink corroborates it, and the wiki's own Anime-Only Characters list holds her. Even if Murata did draw her later, that is a DESIGN crossing into the manga without the events — evidence against adoption (the Twin Star principle), never for it.

OUT OF SCOPE, noted: our TV rows use the broadcast-day convention (ep 1 2015-10-04, ep 12 2015-12-20; TV Tokyo aired Sunday 25:05) while en-WP prints the calendar next day (Oct 5 → Dec 21). Consistent across all 12 rows — no repair proposed, but a future date sweep will see the 1-day gap.

SIBLING CONSISTENCY: this verdict reuses one-punch-man__21386 (Road to Hero, filler) — the same 45-bonus-chapter sweep, the same instrument-lineage control (the fandom's per-episode 'Chapters =' field matches our stored anchors on eps 8-12: 23-26 / 26-29 / 30-32 / 33-35 / 35-37). The OVA pages use a chapterless {{Infobox movie}}, so their silence on chapters is structural; the positive evidence is the licensor's 完全オリジナル copy plus the character-level data.
